mechanism: Both drugs are primarily renally eliminated and can compete for renal clearance; foscarnet may increase amoxicillin levels by reducing tubular secretion, while amoxicillin may reduce foscarnet clearance, potentially increasing foscarnet nephrotoxicity risk.
action: Monitor serum creatinine and renal function closely; ensure adequate hydration; consider dosage adjustments based on creatinine clearance; avoid concurrent use if possible or use with caution in patients with baseline renal impairment.
